topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Oh my gosh, can you believe it? Finding your childhood teddy at a yard sale, it’s like the universe was just waiting for you to come back to it. I mean, think about all the years, all the places it could’ve ended up, and there it was, waiting just for you. It’s like a little piece of your story came back to life. You must be rushing to take it home, holding it like nothing else matters. And the memories, they’re flooding back, right? All those nights, all those secrets, all that comfort. I bet it even smells a bit familiar, a little bit of home, a little bit of you from back then. It’s just... it’s perfect. I’m so glad you found it, really.
